purpose: Merge-only permanent-unlock additions verified after the March 2026 combat modernisation. This file exists so audited dependency edges can land without hand-editing the larger harvested graph.

policy.removed_content_rule: Do not preserve a removed ability as a current unlock merely because an older quest, training, or reward guide still lists it.

historical_removed_unlocks.name: Blood Tendrils
historical_removed_unlocks.reason: Removed during Combat Style Modernisation; older Dig Site/Codex pages may still list the historical four-ability reward.

quest_unlock_additions.league_treatment: Resolve The Dig Site through the official Equilibrium auto-quest overlay before manually gating these three current abilities. Do not restore Blood Tendrils as an Equilibrium unlock unless Jagex explicitly reintroduces it.

activity_unlock_additions.name: Shattered Worlds permanent abilities
activity_unlock_additions.league_treatment: Shattered Worlds moved to the Void Knights' Outpost in November 2025. Asgarnia is a useful access hint because the canonical League map includes Port Sarim, but do not make the off-shore outpost/minigame a hard region gate until Equilibrium publishes locality treatment. Older reward pages that still list Salt the Wound or Greater Dazing Shot are stale after Combat Style Modernisation.

activity_unlock_additions.name: Mazcab / Teci combat ability unlocks
requirements: 15,000 Teci for each direct untradeable ability codex
activity_unlock_additions.league_treatment: Keep Mazcab locality unresolved rather than assigning an overworld region by portal geography. In a self-sufficient League, preserve the direct Teci codex route separately from the tradeable base-game Mazcab ability codex.

activity_unlock_additions.name: Tuska's Wrath current acquisition
activity_unlock_additions.league_treatment: Do not use the removed Anima Islands reward-currency route from old guides. Region availability depends on which current acquisition route Equilibrium makes accessible.

source_conflicts.current: Three current unlocks: Shadow Tendrils, Smoke Tendrils, Ice Asylum.
source_conflicts.stale: Older The Dig Site quick-guide/transcript text still describes Blood Tendrils plus the other three.
source_conflicts.resolution: Use the current Abilities and Quests/Rewards tables plus Blood Tendrils update history. Blood Tendrils was removed on 2 March 2026.

source_conflicts.current: Current Shattered Worlds reward navigation lists Bladed Dive, Slayer's Insight, Kuradal's Favour and Aggression.
source_conflicts.stale: Older reward/training pages may still list Greater Dazing Shot and Salt the Wound.
source_conflicts.resolution: Treat Greater Dazing Shot and Salt the Wound as removed by the March 2026 combat modernisation; keep only current reward-navigation abilities in the permanent graph.
